keywords.note: 'trains' = voice-transcription alias of 'trends' (Evan's spoken list); both kept.

notes: Evan's hot/buzz keywords (2026-11-21). Pages and URLs hitting these take PRIORITY in scraping. 'trains' is an alias of 'trends': Evan dictated the list by voice and 'trains' is the transcription of 'trends' — both spellings are kept so the spoken and written forms both fire. Matching also covers plurals/-ing/-ed forms, misspellings (edit distance), phonetic sound-alikes (sell ~ cell), and encoded forms (leet s3ll, reversed, base64). Keywords change priority, never permission: public pages only, robots respected.
